# Mawsool Actors

> Mawsool publishes LinkedIn and email Actors on Apify. Exact matches are not guessed. No LinkedIn login and no cookies.

## Read

- Find a LinkedIn profile from an email: blog/find-linkedin-from-email.md
- Check the current company before a full scrape: blog/check-linkedin-before-you-scrape.md
- Personal email from a LinkedIn URL: blog/personal-email-from-linkedin.md
- Full actor list: site/llms.txt
